tools.name: search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search CheapestInIndia for products sold in India, with live prices from Amazon, Flipkart, Croma, Reliance Digital, Myntra, Nykaa and other Indian retailers. Use it for any shopping question about products in India: prices, where to buy, options under a budget. For 'is ₹X a good price' or price history of a named product, call get_price_history with `query` directly. Results are ordered category-first: real products before accessories, stores mixed. Put the brand in the query ('samsung 55 inch tv'). Returns products (price, MRP, discount, store, image, buy link, price-history page) and facets (stores, categories, price range). The results are shown to the user as product cards automatically, with a link to all results on CheapestInIndia. Next steps: get_price_history to judge a price, compare_products to compare 2–4 items; render_product_results only to show a hand-picked subset.

tools.name: browse_categories
tools.title: Browse categories
tools.description: List CheapestInIndia product category groups (id + name). Use an id as category_ids in search_products, or as category_id in top_price_drops. Optionally filter by a name fragment.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.title: Price history & price check
tools.description: Price history and price check for a product sold in India, from CheapestInIndia's price tracking: current price, lowest and highest price ever (with dates), lowest in the last 7/30/90 days, how often the price changes, a price chart, and a factual verdict on where today's price sits. Use it for 'is ₹X a good price for <product>?', 'price history of <product>', 'lowest price of <product>', 'was it cheaper before?' and 'should I buy now or has it been lower?'. Pass the product name as `query` (e.g. 'JBL Flip 6') — the best-matching listing is used and other listings are returned so you can switch — or an exact `id` from another tool. Shown to the user as a price-history card with a chart. The verdict describes the past only — never present it as a forecast.

tools.name: top_price_drops
tools.title: Biggest recent price drops
tools.description: Products whose price dropped the most in the last N hours across Indian retailers. Use for 'deals today', 'what got cheaper' or 'price drops on phones'. For a product type, pass `category` as a plain name (e.g. 'air conditioners', 'mobile phones', 'laptops') in the same call — no need to look up an id first. With a category, products are ranked by the rupee drop; without one, by the percentage drop. Each product's priceChange is the drop in INR (negative). Shown to the user as product cards.

tools.name: market_snapshot
tools.title: Price range & budget in India
tools.description: What a type of product costs in India right now, from CheapestInIndia's live listings across Indian stores: price range, median, budget / mid-range / premium price bands with their main brands and example products, and which brands and stores sell it. Use for 'how much does X cost in India', 'how much should I budget for X', 'what does a good X cost', 'price range of X', 'what should I pay for X' and 'which brands sell X in India' — prices in India change daily, so use this rather than general knowledge. Example products from each band are shown to the user as product cards. Computed from the top ~120 search results — a snapshot of current listings, not total market data.
